measurements.scope: Tomczak and Godfrey report approximately 1,200 km from the Florida Straits along the coast to separation near Cape Hatteras. This is the Florida Current segment of the Gulf Stream System, not a whole-system length or a measured reference streamline. NOAA's glossary independently names the same segment; NASA and NOAA Coast Pilot sometimes use Gulf Stream more broadly for the Florida Straits flow.
measurements.source_locator: Chapter 14, The Atlantic Ocean, PDF page 11 (printed page 239), paragraph beginning Recirculation of Gulf Stream water (1,200 km downstream to Cape Hatteras)

widths.boundary_rule: Distance between both jet edges at 50% of the instantaneous core speed in the jet-coordinate downstream velocity profile; author applies a 40 h Hanning temporal filter to the jet metrics.
widths.extraction_method: Transcribed Table 2 width statistics and author-defined threshold/filter; monthly graph values and geographic edges not digitized.
widths.geographic_scope: HF radar jet-coordinate section at 25.42 N off Miami; not the whole Florida Current.
widths.layer: HF radar nominal measurement depth 0.75 m; no fixed vertical layer assigned.
widths.name: Florida Current
widths.range_interpretation: Mean 59 km; observed filtered time-series minimum/maximum 41-76 km across 2005-2006. Standard deviation 6 km and reported mean confidence allowance +/-2 km are separate statistics; confidence percentage is unresolved. These are not per-year or seasonal extrema.
remaining_gates: Recover year-specific monthly values and the source within-month variability envelope or original arrays.
Recover matched geographic boundary coordinates before physical map animation.
widths.section_orientation: Local cross-stream coordinate perpendicular to the detected jet; geographic endpoints not extracted.
widths.source_citation: Archer, Shay and Johns (2017), JGR Oceans 122, 9189-9208, doi:10.1002/2017JC013286.
widths.source_locator: Sections 2.2 and 3.4; Table 1 measurement depth; Table 2 width row and note; Figure 9 caption and section 6 item 5.
widths.source_quality_note: Publisher HTML and original NOAA PDF inspected, including Table 2 and Figure 9. PDF SHA256 matches the NOAA repository receipt. Gray monthly mean curve has a separate extraction artifact; raw HF radar arrays remain unavailable.
widths.time_convention: 2005-2006, year precision; jet metrics filtered with a 40 h Hanning window. Monthly graph readings are provided in a separate diagnostic; this record preserves whole-study statistics.
widths.width_metric_label: Local surface jet: mean and observed range

reported_statistics.confidence_method: Student t distribution with effective degrees of freedom based on integral timescale
